caption_L1: This line chart is named Number of Volkswagen Passat registered cars in Great Britain from 2000 to 2018. The y-axis plots Number of registered cars. On the x-axis, Year is shown along a linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015.
caption_L2L3: The lowest number of pasat cars was in 2000 with under 200,000. The numbers owned peaked at just under 350,000 around 2011 and this was followed by a steady decrease.
